tasks.subject: Task 1: Schema migration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create bin_sub_location, bin_aisle, bin_bay tables and migrate component to FK columns.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/patches/locations_manager_schema.sql`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Three new tables with RLS and tenant isolation
- [ ] component has bin_sub_location_id, bin_aisle_id, bin_bay_id FK columns
- [ ] Old text columns dropped
- [ ] Unique constraints in place

**Verify:** Apply migration, confirm in Supabase dashboard.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/patches/locations_manager_schema.sql"], "verifyCommand": "supabase db push", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Three new tables with RLS", "component FK columns added", "old text columns dropped"]}
```
